title: ReleaseRecord
description: One transition in an agent's harness lineage h0, h1, ... Every release is a bounded, evidenced, reversible edit, never a silent rewrite.

eval_summary.description: The evidence behind the release's numbers: measured (bound to two eval runs, whose deltas these are), attested (deltas the approver vouches for) or rollback (a return to an earlier release).

before.description: Envelope id of the eval run of the current release.

after.description: Envelope id of the eval run of what this release locks.

rollback_to.description: Version restored if this release is rolled back.

signer_public_key.description: Hex Ed25519 public key that signed this release, recorded on the evidence chain.

approval.description: Approver signatures over the exact release, present once the workspace requires signed approvals.

restores.description: Set on a rollback: the earlier release whose manifest, harness and capabilities this release restores.
